concerns.text: The plan conditionally selects the dataset (CTU‑13 if a public mirror is available, otherwise `keys-i/netFlow`). This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) because the source of raw data may change between runs, leading to non‑deterministic results. A single, fixed dataset source must be used for all runs, or the fallback must be explicitly version‑pinned and documented as part of the reproducibility guarantee.
